current_state.zh: SoFi 已宣布计息代币化存款 SoFi Earn（SOFIE），年化 4.4%，在适用限额内受 FDIC 保险，预计 11 月向加密会员全面上线；SOFIE 可 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD，SoFiUSD 本身不属于 FDIC 保险存款。
current_state.en: SoFi has announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit at 4.4% APY, FDIC-insured within applicable limits, with full rollout to crypto members expected in November; SOFIE is convertible 1:1 into SoFiUSD, which itself is not an FDIC-insured deposit.

updates.what_changed_zh: SoFi 推出 SoFi Earn（SOFIE），这是一种计息代币化存款，年化收益率 4.4%，在适用限额内享有 FDIC 保险，可按 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD 稳定币，成为美国国民银行首个直接面向零售的代币化存款产品。
updates.what_changed_en: SoFi launched SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit paying 4.4% APY and FDIC-insured within applicable limits, convertible 1:1 into the SoFiUSD stablecoin, marking the first direct retail tokenized-deposit offering by a US national bank.

updates.title_zh: 【SoFi 将推出计息代币化存款产品 SoFi Earn，支持将存款转换为 SoFiUSD】
updates.title_en: 【SoFi 将推出计息代币化存款产品 SoFi Earn，支持将存款转换为 SoFiUSD】
updates.what_changed_zh: 报道澄清 SoFi Earn 是已宣布、预计 11 月全面上线，而非已完成全面推出；并补充 SOFIE 可按 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD、用于购买加密货币或转至外部钱包，且 SoFiUSD 本身不受 FDIC 保险。
updates.what_changed_en: The report clarifies that SoFi Earn was announced with full rollout expected in November, rather than fully launched; it adds that SOFIE can be converted 1:1 into SoFiUSD for crypto purchases or external wallet transfers, and that SoFiUSD itself is not FDIC-insured.
updates.current_state_zh: SoFi 已宣布计息代币化存款 SoFi Earn（SOFIE），年化 4.4%，在适用限额内受 FDIC 保险，预计 11 月向加密会员全面上线；SOFIE 可 1:1 兑换为 SoFiUSD，SoFiUSD 本身不属于 FDIC 保险存款。
updates.current_state_en: SoFi has announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit at 4.4% APY, FDIC-insured within applicable limits, with full rollout to crypto members expected in November; SOFIE is convertible 1:1 into SoFiUSD, which itself is not an FDIC-insured deposit.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: SoFi announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit paying 4.4% APY and FDIC-insured within applicable limits, which members can convert 1:1 into the SoFiUSD stablecoin via SoFi Crypto to buy crypto or transfer to external wallets, with full rollout expected in November.
updates.detailed_summary_en: SoFi announced SoFi Earn (SOFIE), an interest-bearing tokenized deposit paying 4.4% APY and FDIC-insured within applicable limits, which members can convert 1:1 into the SoFiUSD stablecoin via SoFi Crypto to buy crypto or transfer to external wallets, with full rollout expected in November.
